name: nginx-multisite
description: Installs and runs Nginx for three virtual hosts, serves static content, redirects HTTP to HTTPS, creates development TLS certificates, and applies host and web-server security controls.

name: cache
description: Installs and enables Memcached and Redis, configures Redis on port 6379 with authentication and logging, and applies the required cache filesystem and configuration settings.

name: fastapi-tutorial
description: Installs Python and PostgreSQL prerequisites, deploys the FastAPI tutorial application, configures its virtual environment and database, and manages a systemd service running Uvicorn on port 8000.
